heading: Missions
intro: Follow the signal. Find your courage. Type them home.
story: Fight through the lunar storm. Bring one astronaut home.
relaxedHint: More time to find your rhythm
standardHint: Faster waves. Less room for hesitation.
challengeHint: Tight deadlines. Push beyond your usual pace.
paceHelp: Threats give you time based on this pace. Choose a lower number if you’re still learning.
instruction1: Type a target’s first letter to lock on. Finish the word to fire.
instruction2: Backspace corrects mistakes. Rocks hit health hardest; sharp debris damages oxygen most.
instruction3: Movement is automatic. Escape pauses the mission.
keyboard: Connect a physical keyboard to play. You can explore the mission map on any screen.
local: Saved on this device · separate from practice records
pausedHint: Your rescue deadline, oxygen, and approaching threats are paused. Resume when you’re ready.
leaveHint: End the mission to save a partial result without unlocking the next destination.
transitionHint: No typing needed during this sequence.
type: Type here to continue the mission
chooseHint: Type a word above to fire.
repairHint: Match every character. Backspace corrects a mistake.
paste: Use your keyboard for this rescue. Pasting is disabled.
combatSoundHint: Layered impacts, warning tones, and cinematic engine sound.
fullscreenUnavailable: Full screen is unavailable in this browser. The wide cockpit is still ready to play.
crewSafe: One more person made it home.
successText: The beacon is back online. Your passenger is safe aboard. That little signal became a way home.
failureTitle: The next rescue starts with you.
failureText: Your life support failed before extraction. Try Explorer difficulty for more time to intercept threats.
scoreHint: Earn a star for extraction, another for at least 95% accuracy, and a third for keeping 100% health.
paceNote: Mission WPM excludes travel sequences and pauses. Mission scores stay separate from standard typing tests.
saveFailed: Your mission could not be saved. Keep this result open and try again.
temporary: Kept for this visit only — browser storage is unavailable
worldsHint: This first expedition is fully playable. Mars and Jupiter’s moons are charted for future missions.
quickInstruction: Clear the threats. Finish the rescue before oxygen runs out.
unlockRule: A win on any difficulty opens the next destination.
nextUnlocked: {destination} unlocked. Your next rescue is ready.
oxygenHint: Oxygen drains throughout the mission. Impacts also damage your suit and oxygen supply.
endedText: Your run ended early. Complete the rescue to unlock the next destination.
failureHealth: Your suit health reached zero. Destroy incoming threats before they reach you.
failureOxygen: Your oxygen ran out. Impacts damage your supply, so clearing threats preserves breathing time.
failureTimeout: The rescue window closed. Try clearing the objectives faster on your next run.
